gen-comfortaa-gf-stick: Neon-tube curves, loosely strung out. Comfortaa stretches its spacing like an uncoiled spring, while Stick keeps constant-weight lines with wide exits, so a whole paragraph slides along smoothly.
gen-comfortaa-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antique: Round, friendly, stretched out. Comfortaa sets the mood up top with neon-tube strokes, while Zen Kaku Gothic Antique keeps its bends smooth and its t crossbar matched to the stem below.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-taviraj: Strong, commanding, cut from tubing. Aaargh is best at hammering a point home with uniform stems and bowls, while Taviraj is best at bookish, editorial finesse with medium contrast.
gen-dafont-aaargh-gf-uchen: Strong, round, and cut from one gauge. Aaargh keeps every bowl wall uniform and commanding, while Uchen, a serif, adds understated stroke contrast and a dignified, refined tone beneath.
gen-dafont-arkhip-gf-cutive: Modern, and happily floating apart. Arkhip does best with strokes of uniform thickness and paperclip-open curves, while Cutive does best at refined, literary, wide-tracked text with low contrast.
